subject.title: marketplace-crons: Amazon notifications-pull recibe 500 en getOrder

question: Should Hamelyn add bounded local retry/backoff for Amazon Orders `getOrder` 500s in the notification pull flow, or leave this as provider escalation with SQS-level retry only?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the safe handling depends on current SP-API behavior and Hamelyn's quota/error-budget tolerance.

options.title: Add bounded retry
options.body: Wrap `getOrder` with the shared HTTP retry helper using a small retry budget and preserve failed-message retention.

options.title: Provider escalation only
options.body: Keep current SQS retry behavior and track the failing request/order IDs with Amazon until SP-API recovers.

recommendation.title: Add bounded retry
recommendation.body: Wrap `getOrder` with the shared HTTP retry helper using a small retry budget and preserve failed-message retention.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame places the central notification processor and Amazon order API wrapper on this path.
